messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: High GPU utilization in us-west-2 gpu-pool-primaries. autoscaler not adding nodes; inference latency spiking >1.2s p95. Trigger: GPU exhaustion.

oncall-bot: Incident severity: SEV2. Runbook: gpu-shortage -> follow fallback playbook if scale doesn't kick by +10m.

alex: seeing huge enqueue backlog on the prediction queue, confirmed increased OOMs on a few pods. autoscaler logs show frequent scale attempts but failed scheduling due to node group capacity limits.

maya: onboarded. jumping in to check node pool quotas and cloud error events. tagging infra.

cheng: adding context — we pushed a new quantized model yesterday to canary in us-west-2 public; it uses more vram under certain seq lengths. Could be contributing to pressure.

linda: I'm scoping customer impact: a subset of enterprise customers in US-W are reporting timeouts on embeddings and chat. Support queued alerts. No billing anomalies yet.

ryan: oncall infra; quota shows we've hit the provider regional GPU soft limit. autoscaler is fine, but new nodes can't be provisioned. Requesting quota increase now, but that won't be immediate.

maya: mitigation idea — enable cross-region fallback routing to us-east-1 for non-data-regulated customers to shed load. Can we flip traffic quickly?

alex: we have fallback policy but routing requires model compatibility check; fallback to gpt-redwood-small (quantized) may work for embeddings and non-prod chat. For enterprise contracts we need to confirm allowed region.

cheng: quick test — reroute a small subset (5%) to us-east-1: config snippet below

```yaml
routing: 
  - priority: regional-us-west-2
  - fallback: regional-us-east-1
  - percent: 5
```

maya: executed the 5% canary. Observed drop in enqueue backlog for the canary subset. latency for canary requests in us-east-1 is good.

linda: support update: 5 customers affected heavily, we're sending status updates. no data exfiltration. marking as partial-degradation.

ryan: cloud provider responded — soft quota increase request in progress, ETA ~45m. Meanwhile I can manually spin warm nodes in a different node group (different instance family) and patch autoscaler to target them. That will accept scheduling.

alex: go for it, please try smaller instance types first to keep cost down. Also enable aggressive pod eviction on low-priority jobs (batch/replica-inference) to free GPUs.

ryan: started warm node provisioning (g4dn -> g5a fallback). autoscaler updated with new node group target; scheduling success for a few pods.

maya: monitoring — GPU pool utilization dropped 18% after routing + new nodes + eviction. enqueue backlog trending down.

cheng: still seeing model memory spike for the new quantized canary. I'll roll back the canary version to previous quantized build (v2 -> v1) to reduce VRAM.

alex: rollback approved. cheng — please coordinate with maya to avoid simultaneous changes.

cheng: rolled back canary at 2055560200. quick sanity checks look good.

postmortem-bot: Reminder: schedule a post-incident review within 72 hours. Use template: impact, timeline, root cause, contributing factors, remediation, owner assignments.

linda: scheduling now. proposing 2055580000 (48h out) 10:00 PT for 60m. invite: eng-runtime, eng-sre, infra, support.

alex: action items (initial):
- A1: verify provider quota and request automation to pre-warn at 80% regional GPU usage (owner: ryan)
- A2: add regional fallback healthchecks to avoid routing incompatible model versions (owner: cheng)
- A3: refine autoscaler scheduling to detect nodegroup capacity failures and try alternate nodegroups automatically (owner: maya)
- A4: add an emergency warm-node playbook for manual provisioning and runbook steps (owner: alex)

ryan: taking A1. I'll add alerting to the cloud-metrics dashboard and a daily job to reconcile quotas vs fleet.

cheng: taking A2. I'll add model-compat checks into routing policy and a lightweight preflight that validates KV cache shapes and seq length memory before routing.

maya: taking A3. I'll add failure mode logic into the autoscaler and a metric for "nodegroup-sched-fails" that triggers fallback.

alex: I'll own A4 and draft the playbook today. also will own postmortem write-up root cause section.

linda: support action: update customer comms template to include fallback regional routing and expected latency differences (owner: linda).

postmortem-bot: Postmortem ticket created: PM-2055555. Add notes and link any runbook changes.

maya: small follow-up — we should consider limiting new model pushes to region-by-region gradual ramps (e.g., 1% -> 5% -> 25%) to detect Vram regressions earlier. Add as A5 (owner: cheng).

cheng: ack A5. will implement staged rollout policy and add a regression test for peak VRAM with long sequences.

alex: closing timeline: incident declared at 2055555555, mitigation in place by 2055560300 (routing + warm nodes), full service recovered by ~2055561200. Will mark for retrospective.

linda: thanks all — keeping this thread open for remediation updates. please add short status updates as you make progress. :thumbsup:
